Privacy Policy

Effective Date: August 12, 2026

This policy applies to ISS Tracker on Android and iOS. The app does not require an account and does not ask you to provide your name, email address, or phone number.

Location

ISS Tracker requests location permission only for features that need your position, such as finding visible ISS passes and configuring pass alerts. Location coordinates may be sent to the pass-prediction provider to return results for that location. Alert coordinates and settings may be stored locally on your device. ISS Tracker does not operate a developer-owned server that stores your location history.

Local App Data

Your theme, map preferences, alert configuration, scheduled notification identifiers, review eligibility, and advertising launch count are stored locally using platform storage. Existing Android storage names and keys are retained during the multiplatform migration so an app update does not reset these choices.

Notifications and Calendar

Notification, exact-alarm, background refresh, and calendar actions are used only when you enable or invoke the related feature. You can revoke platform permissions in system settings.

Advertising and Consent

ISS Tracker uses Google AdMob and Google User Messaging Platform. Advertising requests begin only when Google\'s consent status says ads may be requested. Depending on your region and choices, Google and its partners may process device information, IP address, advertising identifiers, approximate location, and ad interactions to deliver and measure ads.

On iOS, App Tracking Transparency may present Apple\'s system permission when tracking permission is applicable. The app remains usable if you decline. A Privacy Choices entry is shown when Google requires one.

Google\'s privacy policy is available at https://policies.google.com/privacy.

Purchases

The optional lifetime ad-removal purchase is processed by Google Play or the Apple App Store. ISS Tracker receives the resulting entitlement status and stores an ad-removal flag locally, but does not receive or store your payment-card details.

Analytics and Diagnostics

ISS Tracker uses Google Analytics for Firebase to measure app launches, sessions, active users, screen views, feature interactions, settings changes, and purchase-flow outcomes. This helps understand general usage and improve the app. ISS Tracker does not send precise coordinates, saved location names, astronaut names, live-stream URLs, calendar or notification contents, support-email contents, payment-card details, transaction identifiers, or raw diagnostic messages as custom analytics parameters. The Analytics SDK uses an app-instance identifier and may derive approximate location and device information as described by Google. Advertising personalization signals from Analytics are disabled by default.

Developer diagnostic logs are limited to debug builds. Release builds remove app-authored Android logs that may contain SDK error details; analytics events remain enabled because they are structured usage measurements rather than diagnostic logs.

Third-Party Data Providers

The app retrieves ISS position, pass prediction, crew, biography, image, map, and live-stream information from third-party services. Requests may expose standard network information such as your IP address and device networking metadata to those providers.

Children

ISS Tracker is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect account information from children. Advertising configuration and store audience declarations must remain consistent with the audiences selected for each release.

Your Choices

You can deny location, notification, tracking, or advertising consent where offered. You can reset locally stored app data and the Analytics app-instance identifier by uninstalling the app or using the platform\'s storage controls.

Changes and Contact

This policy may be updated when app features or third-party services change. Questions can be sent to restartapplication@gmail.com.
